data.content: # Mets predicted to win bidding war for $32M two-time Cy Young winner to stabilize rotation. It is no secret that the New York Mets were baseball's most disappointing team in 2026, with injuries and poor play contributing to their struggles. This offseason will be a significant one for the organization as it looks to put together the right roster for a turnaround. Whether it is the bullpen or the starting rotation, New York is going to need to add pitching this offseason. Upgrading the starting rotation remains a top priority, but the Mets also need to revamp their bullpen after trading away four relievers at the deadline,” SI’s Tommy Kelson wrote. One thing that is clear in New York is that Nolan McLean has all the talent necessary to become the team's ace in 2027 and beyond.
